findings.highlight: The sound of rain echoes inside the chapel
findings.evidenceJa: 長く、雨の音だけが響く礼拝堂
findings.governingReading: For a long while, only the sound of rain echoes through the chapel.
findings.explanation: The English removes the duration and exclusive silence before Kirei arrives.

findings.highlight: the extraction of an eleven-year old pus
findings.evidenceJa: 十一年に渡る膿の摘出
findings.governingReading: the extraction of corruption or pus accumulated across eleven years
findings.explanation: The English produces a malformed image of one piece of “eleven-year-old pus” rather than treatment of eleven years’ accumulated damage.

findings.evidenceJa: どれほど高価な代償なのか
findings.governingReading: how costly a price Kirei paid
findings.explanation: The English reverses an expensive sacrifice into valuable compensation received.

findings.highlight: threw away all of his fortune
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の財産を全て売っぱらった
findings.governingReading: sold off all his property or fortune
findings.explanation: The English changes costly liquidation for Sakura’s sake into wasteful disposal.

findings.highlight: remove most of the crest worm
findings.evidenceJa: 大部分の刻印虫は取り除けた
findings.governingReading: remove most of the crest worms
findings.explanation: The English turns a population of embedded worms into portions of one worm.

findings.highlight: the crest worm that did not metabolize with her nerves
findings.evidenceJa: 神経と同化していない刻印虫
findings.governingReading: crest worms that had not fused with her nerves
findings.explanation: Assimilation into Sakura’s nerves becomes the physiologically incoherent claim that the worm did not metabolize with them.

findings.governingReading: He is neither surprised nor hesitant.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Shirou’s lack of moral hesitation with lack of intellectual confusion.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry for making you use your Crest
findings.evidenceJa: 刻印を使い切ってくれた綺礼には悪いけど
findings.governingReading: Though Rin feels bad for Kirei, who used up his Crest for them.
findings.explanation: The English directly addresses an unspecified “you” and says Rin caused the expenditure, replacing her third-person acknowledgment of Kirei’s sacrifice.
